found.name: Global Game Jam at Kent State (Design Innovation Hub)
found.reason: Search snippets of kent.edu/node/1016663 describe a 2026 GGJ site at the Design Innovation Hub, Jan 30-Feb 1 2026, hosted by the Animation Game Design Program and club and open to 'all college students in the region'. The page now returns 403 'There is no content here' to curl and to WebFetch, so I could not read it. No globalgamejam.org jam-site page was found under the guessed slugs, and no 2027 site is announced (GGJ 2027 is Jan 25-31, and site registration opened Nov 1). The only earlier Kent State site was at Tuscarawas (New Philadelphia) in 2019, so there is no proof it repeats in Kent. Not added.
